item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -eu
echo "AGMS_RUN=$AGMS_RUN"
mkdir -p "$AGMS_RUN/evidence"
sha256sum /opt/agms/pkg/bin/corbanu /opt/agms/packet/design-cases.md /opt/agms/packet/amendments-and-new-cases.md
agms-probe all > "$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-executor.json"
rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
cat "$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-executor.json"
echo '"'--- preflight-summary.json ---'
cat \""'$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-summary.json"
echo '"'--- other preflight files ---'
for f in \""'$AGMS_RUN/evidence"/preflight-*.json; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done'
